name: Housekeep
description: Housekeep is a benchmark for evaluating commonsense reasoning in embodied AI, where agents must tidy virtual households by rearranging misplaced objects according to human preferences without explicit instructions. It includes a dataset of object placements in tidy and untidy houses and tests agents' planning, exploration, and navigation capabilities.
reputation: A niche embodied-AI benchmark that is useful for studying commonsense household rearrangement, but it has limited adoption compared with larger embodied navigation and manipulation suites.
notes: Dataset includes 1799 objects, 268 categories, 585 placements, and 105 rooms; baseline integrates planning and LLM-based reasoning.
